body_html:
@khurtwilliams This is a great piece. Just bookmarked get's at both the why and how we need to build these skills in people.

Literacy has always been about privilege and power. Why would web be different?

And only way to ensure dominant literacies don't hold power of others is to ensure you do the hard work of providing literacy skills while acknowledging the local knowledge and power communities bring to the table.
